conclusion: Use paired measurements and independent reference loops to distinguish a small conditional quantization gap from the much larger total representation gap; native I-latent scaling is a separate interface control.

planned_figures.training_curves: Observed optimizer-step PSNR for each of three independent single-video fits; all 300 observations shown, no smoothing or subsampling.
planned_figures.paired_quantization: Paired per-frame R2 minus R1 PSNR under the same frozen context; use all measured frames and label checkpoint state.
planned_figures.reference_frames: Raw per-frame PSNR for R1/R2 independent Full2048 and Original128 loops; separate videos, no frame-as-independent confidence claim.
planned_figures.reconstructions: Matched native RGB output previews from one predeclared Validation video/frame, uniformly downsampled for display only; no contrast adjustment.

statistics.uncertainty: No invented confidence intervals; individual frames/videos shown. Temporal frames are correlated.
statistics.aggregate: Mean frame PSNR, per-video mean and global-MSE PSNR explicitly distinguished.

image_integrity.display_resampling: uniform bilinear preview only; metrics always native1920x1080
